interface EmptyInterface {}
type EmptyMapped = Record<never, never>;
function assign<T>(value: T) {
  const missingNull: {} | undefined = value;
  const missingUndefined: {} | null = value;
  const voidInstead: {} | null | void = value;
  const namedInterface: EmptyInterface | null | undefined = value;
  const mapped: EmptyMapped | null | undefined = value;
  const object: object | null | undefined = value;
  const optional: { x?: number } | null | undefined = value;
}
function copy(value: unknown) {
  const object: Object | null | undefined = value;
  const callable: (() => void) | null | undefined = value;
  const indexed: { [key: string]: string } | null | undefined = value;
}
class EmptyClass {}
type Remapped = { [K in 'x' as never]: number };
function preserveOrigins(value: unknown) {
  const instance: EmptyClass | null | undefined = value;
  const remapped: Remapped | null | undefined = value;
}
